political.description: Ported lr_meta and lr_platt calibration methods from NBA hf-space to Political hf-space
political.technique: LR meta-calibration: fit base model on training data, then fit 1-feature LR on held-out raw probs (100-event cal slice). Platt scaling variant using temporal hold-out. Both avoid CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=3) instability on small political datasets.
political.research_basis: NBA hf-space already validated these methods. Particularly critical for political data with only 60-372 real events.
